newsitem.title: KENYA: Two Somali refugees burned to death in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Two Somali refugees burned to death in Kenya.

text.p: Two Somali refugees were burned to death on Thursday and an estimated 14,000 were left homeless after a fire swept through their camp north of the Kenyan port of Mombasa.
Refugee witnesses said the fire was started by Giriama tribesmen after a refugee in a quarrel stabbed an elder of the tribe, which owns the land where Sswaleh Nguru camp is located.
